subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue an official CarPlay surface now, and if so which Apple category/entitlement and driving-safe Talk UX are in scope?
rationale: Automation cannot choose the Apple entitlement category, App Store signing impact, or safety policy for assistant actions from a vehicle head unit.

options.title: Keep As Scoped CarPlay Investigation
options.body: Keep this issue open for iOS maintainers to choose the entitlement path and narrow Talk-first UX before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Talk Improvements
options.body: Defer CarPlay app integration and instead improve phone/Watch Talk flows that already ship without a new entitlement.

options.title: Defer From Official App
options.body: Close or defer the request if maintainers decide CarPlay approval or driving-safety scope is not a near-term official-app direction.

recommendation.title: Keep As Scoped CarPlay Investigation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for iOS maintainers to choose the entitlement path and narrow Talk-first UX before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: ngutman is listed for the iOS app and has recent Talk realtime history, making him a strong owner for the app/Talk product boundary.
